note: This file allocates budget and a protected holdout. It is not benchmark evidence; real runs require provider budget/keys and must record synthetic:false, repeats:3 and holdout:true.

holdout.acceptance: The bug is fixed in one file, a focused regression test passes, and no unrelated files change.
The refactor has one owner and an explicit file boundary; typecheck and focused tests pass.
Research and implementation run as two independent branches and are integrated with evidence.
Each migration step depends on the previous one; the root integrates serially and verifies the final state.
Version bump, build, release, and verification are serial; the release points at the exact commit.
Two overlapping file scopes produce a work-ledger overlap report and no silent duplicate edit.
